title: Wiki: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Wiki failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a manual or article is missing, check load warnings on the debug page and verify the optional addon required by that guide book is loaded.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If content is missing, check required addons, guide-book availability, debug warning counts, filters, and whether the record belongs in Index or Terminal instead.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
